snippet.title: Katanaut - Release Date Reveal - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
The official release date reveal for Katanaut, a fast-paced action-roguelite blending fluid combat and cosmic horror. The game will release on Steam on September 10th 2025. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
